events.summary: Dr. Madison Li contributes her genius to Project Purity and later to the Institute.
events.quote: Dr. Madison Li's genius was an asset for both Project Purity and, later, the Institute.

events.summary: At the onset of the Great War, Nuka-Cola's best minds are reassigned to weapons development.
events.quote: At the onset of the Great War, Nuka-Cola's best minds were reassigned to weapons development.

events.summary: In 2271 the Desert Rangers of Nevada and NCR rangers sign the Ranger Unification Treaty.
events.quote: In the year 2271, the Desert Rangers of Nevada and rangers of the New California Republic met at this spot to sign the Ranger Unification Treaty.

events.summary: James floods the room with radiation to keep Project Purity from the Enclave and dies telling his child to run.
events.quote: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

events.summary: RobCo's Assaultron reserves, thought destroyed in the Great War, prove merely dormant.
events.quote: In reality, they were merely dormant.

events.summary: Grognak becomes king with just his axe.
events.quote: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

events.summary: The Poseidon oil rig, an Enclave fortress, becomes the site of the Enclave's greatest defeat.
events.quote: eventually, the site of their greatest defeat.

events.summary: Mutant strangler vines carry Tanagra up into the treetops.
events.quote: Mutant strangler vines carried the town of Tanagra up into the treetops, where it remains to this day.

events.summary: The Institute's FEV experiments fail, and Shaun's DNA makes organic synths possible.
events.quote: The Institute's FEV experiments failed. Only Shaun's DNA made organic synths possible.

events.summary: The Master builds his army by sending captured humans to the vats.
events.quote: Humans, preferably with little radiation damage, were captured and sent to the vats.

events.summary: The Master creates centaurs by tossing a human, dog and cat into FEV and unleashes them.
events.quote: He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

events.summary: Desdemona sets the assault on the Institute in motion.
events.quote: "Assaulting the Institute has been set irrevocably in motion.

events.summary: In the Battle of Hoover Dam, rangers lure Caesar's Legion into Boulder City and blow it up.
events.quote: The rangers lured the best of Caesar's Legion into Boulder City, then blew the whole town up.

events.summary: The Rockhound excavator devastates the area, creating the Ash Heap.
events.quote: Its mining efforts devastated the area and transformed the land into the Ash Heap.

events.summary: Oliver Swanick wins the Nipton lottery, a chance to live another day.
events.quote: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

events.summary: Elder Nolan McNamara breaks the Chain That Binds, leading to Hardin's coup.
events.quote: Elder Nolan McNamara broke the Chain That Binds, starting the events which led to Hardin's coup.

events.summary: The Overseer bids farewell as residents leave Vault 76.
events.quote: "It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."

events.summary: Operation: Anchorage showcases winterized T-51b power armor.
events.quote: Operation: Anchorage showcased the effectiveness of the winterized T-51b power armor.

events.summary: Fist holds Strong and Rex prisoner atop the Commonwealth's tallest tower.
events.quote: Atop the tallest tower in the Commonwealth resides Fist, the leader of the super mutants, and his prized prisoners: Strong and Rex.
